feature_contract.goal: Request one bounded recovery of a missing OpenXR host while OutRun is running, without claiming that process creation establishes functioning Quest3 VR.
feature_contract.scope_boundary: DX9Ex Windows test launcher and packaged validation only. No game rendering, FFB, input, shaders, DX11, or frozen DXVK behavior.
feature_contract.special_work_evidence: User's DX9Ex test ZIP recorded gamePid=3728, hostPid=0, hostReason=host-pid-missing and stereoAllowed=0; a launched game had no OpenXR host.
trace_stages: DX9Ex selected backend installs game and host binaries with expected source identity.
The initial OpenXR host prewarm isolates VR transport flags before launching the game.
While the game remains alive the process-health loop retries exactly once after confirmed absence.
The same session captures attempted recovery and real host-process failure without treating HMD optics as verified.
subcomponents: Host absence gets one bounded matching-configuration retry without forcefully ending the game.
Recovered or missing host and native-game failures preserve root diagnostics in the archived test session.

acceptance_items.expected_behavior: One restart request occurs only after sustained host absence and cannot repeat after a later host loss.
The process monitor keeps the game running, permits a bounded recovery grace and records an actual missing host after failure.
Recovery uses existing matching OpenXR transport policy, restores parent environment and archives retry outcome.
PowerShell AST parse, negative launcher mutations, x86 game, x64 host, package and Domain gate pass at the same SHA.

diagnosis.original_evidence: Game PID 3728 but no OpenXR host and stereoAllowed=0 in a real DX9Ex user test.
diagnosis.root_cause: The monitored launcher prewarmed once and only reported a missing host; it had no bounded recovery path while the game stayed alive.
source_trace: Selected test launcher copies the correct DX9Ex game/host into the original game directory.
PowerShell launches an asynchronous host with isolated environment then runs the game.
The original health loop observed missing host then broke to log collection with no reattempt.
The revised health loop requests one host restart and then observes the real process for ten seconds.
alternatives_rejected: No new DXVK path, repeated restart loop, forced exit of running game or unverified HMD/session success claim.
diagnosis.fix_evidence: PowerShell host-health loop now includes exactly one bounded process-restart attempt; archive stores recovery state.
diagnosis.negative_test_evidence: Launch verifier has destructive mutations for retry guard, grace timing and missing health evidence plus Windows AST syntax parse.

runtime_evidence: Quest3/VDXR not executed on this commit; startup retry is not an OpenXR session or binocular proof.
c6_record_reconciliation: Resolved prior TERMINAL_STATUS_NOT_COMPLETE hold with exact-SHA required Actions SUCCESS; original feature_contract and C2 acceptance_results snapshot preserved without overwriting per-item pending values. No source rebuild or duplicate score.
